detail.longDescription:
Keep your trusted circle connected with clear, consent-based location sharing.
SafeNest — Family GPS is a family locator and phone location app designed for everyday safety, travel coordination, and simple check-ins between people who trust each other. It helps you view live location updates, follow important arrivals and departures, understand basic device context, and send SOS support when it matters most.
Key Highlights:
📍 Live Location Sharing
Share real-time location with your family or trusted contacts and check in throughout the day. Whether you are arranging pickups, meeting friends, following a trip, or confirming that someone reached a destination safely, SafeNest — Family GPS keeps updates easy to read and simple to manage.
🛡️ Place Alerts
Create trusted places such as home, school, work, or other routine stops. When a member arrives or leaves, the app can send a helpful notification so daily routines are easier to follow without repeated manual messages.
🔋 Battery and Device Context
See useful status details that add context when someone is on the move or temporarily hard to reach. These signals help your circle understand what may be happening without turning location sharing into hidden monitoring.
🚨 SOS Support
When urgent help is needed, send a quick SOS alert to your trusted circle. The feature is built for fast communication, family safety, and stressful moments when every second matters.
🗺️ Clear Map Experience
Use a clean map view to understand shared locations, movement updates, and saved places without unnecessary clutter. The experience is designed for practical daily use and easy coordination.
SafeNest — Family GPS is intended for consent-based sharing between trusted people. It should be used for family safety, meetups, travel coordination, and everyday peace of mind, not secret tracking or unlawful surveillance.
